approval.statement: The operator supplied and approved Groq with qwen/qwen3.6-27b. The agent did not select a provider or model. Credentials are read only from GROQ_API_KEY and are never committed.

anthropic.note: Implemented client path retained. A different provider still requires a new operator approval and a new freeze.

groq.sdk: Groq OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (urllib; no extra SDK required)
groq.note: Operator-approved live path. Key from GROQ_API_KEY only. No GROQ_MODEL override.

boundedUses: Judge whether proposed walls and openings are visually consistent with the evidence frames.
Report whether a named surface appears partially occluded.
Report whether an apparent opening could instead be incomplete coverage or occlusion.
Name a broad, visually plausible room type.
Name the entity IDs that need human review, and why.
Classify a nominated opening-candidate region with registered multi-view evidence.
Propose a visible condition and a registered image region; never a metric quantity.
prohibitedUses: Creating, deleting, resizing, repositioning, or relabelling canonical geometry.
Emitting or altering any dimension, transform, floor area, or measurement.
Producing square footage, linear extent, or any restoration quantity.
Overwriting benchmark references or benchmark results.
Writing into production damage[] or scope[].
Silently substituting a different provider or model.
imagesPerRequestRationale: engineering_constraint. Groq documents a 3-image model cap, and this POC further caps at 3. A measured 3-image request on the operator-approved model returned HTTP 413: on_demand TPM Limit 8000, Requested ~12734. One image per request is the largest payload that fits that limit. Three registered views remain selected; only the first is sent in a single Groq call. On-disk evidence is unchanged.

retryPolicy.http429: honour Retry-After, cap wait at 30s, at most 4 attempts
retryPolicy.timeoutRetry: one bounded retry, then fail closed
retryPolicy.requestImageEncoding: JPEG long-edge 128px, quality 50; on-disk PNG evidence is unchanged. Engineering constraint: Groq on_demand TPM is 8000 and three full-resolution PNG frames exceeded it (HTTP 413, requested ~13k tokens).

expectedLatencyClass: seconds to tens of seconds for one request with 3 images
expectedCostClass: single-request, low; one call per scan review

dataHandling.developmentFrames: Public ARKitScenes frames. No personal content is expected.
dataHandling.finalCaptureFrames: Private interior photographs of a real bedroom. These must not be sent to any provider without explicit operator approval recorded above, because approval here is also the disclosure that private imagery leaves the machine.
dataHandling.retentionNote: Whatever retention the approved provider applies becomes the retention for those frames. That is part of what the operator is approving.
dataHandling.credentialNote: GROQ_API_KEY is read from the local environment. It is never written into this file, never logged, and never committed.

onAccessFailure: Record the failure verbatim, emit not_run, leave geometry and every measurement untouched, and let the pipeline continue. AI is never on the critical path for Artifacts 1-11. No substitute provider or model is selected.

decisionRecord.whyThisModel: The operator supplied and approved Groq qwen/qwen3.6-27b. The agent did not choose it. Groq documents this model as multimodal with image input, JSON mode, and a request image cap that this POC further restricts to 3.
decisionRecord.alternativesConsidered: Not evaluated by the agent. No second model and no model-comparison project is permitted. A different provider or model requires a new operator approval.
decisionRecord.whySufficientForTheBoundedTask: The task is a visual consistency judgement over at most three registered frames against a compact geometry summary, with a strict output schema and no authority over any number. The approved model is documented as accepting images and JSON mode.
decisionRecord.whatItIsNotTrustedToDo: Anything in prohibitedUses. Geometry owns every metric value; the verifier may only append an assessment.
decisionRecord.whatPrivateDataCouldBeSent: Up to 3 RGB frames of the scanned room plus a compact JSON summary of surface IDs, types, dimensions, and observation states. No raw depth, no point cloud, no capture bundle, and no API key.
decisionRecord.whatHappensIfAccessFails: See onAccessFailure. The verifier fails closed.
